tei:div.tei:p: 505)༄༅/ gnam chos thugs gter la brten pa'i bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba zhugs so/ 506)

bskal mang du mar 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// 'di phyi gang la'ang brten na mi bslu ba'i// rgyal ba kun dngos mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs// rtsibs steng 'od chags bar ba spyi bor bkod// gang gi gsang gsum mi zad mchod sdong la// mchod chog me tog phreng ba dad pa yi// srad bur brgyus la chos bdag srung ma dang*// gter bdag yal gam can gyis bka' gnang stsol/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu rang la ye nas gnas kyang de'i ston pa bla ma yin pas/ bla ma ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas 507) las kyang lhag cing gnyan par rgyud lung mtha' dag nas gsungs pa yin te/ gsang 'dus las/ mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs nas// bla ma'i mchod pa yang dag brtsam// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen pa'i// ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ ces dang*/ mi lce phreng ba'i rgyud las/ gal te rnal 'byor blo ldan gyis// rang zas gos la gyong khur nas// bla ma rdo rje mchod pa la// zhing gi khor yug rgyal khams na// dge slong dpag tu med pa la/ 508) / ston mo lan stong byas pa bas// zas sam yang na gos kyang rung*// bla ma lan gcig mchod pa yi// bsod nams brgya phrag brjod mi rdzogs/ zhes dang*// rgyud bkod pa chen po las/ bla ma sgom dang bstod dang bsam pa yis// sangs rgyas 'bras bu zhag gcig 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so/ de la 'dir sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum gyis ston de/ dang po sbyor ba bcas kyi rim pa ni/ rten khebs steng du maṇḍal dri bzang gi 'bru tshom dang*/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba bsham/ dal mdun rig ma rgyan ldan/ sman raka gtor ma zlum po zas snas brgyan pa dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ 'thor 'thung gi dri chu sogs legs par bshams nas/ skyabs sems mchod brlab rten bskyed dgug /bgegs sbyong bskrad bsrung gnyis med bsre/ zhes pa ltar sngon 'gro'i chos la bdun las/

dang po skyabs sems ni/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: skyabs gnas rnams la skyabs su 509) mchi: 'gro kun sangs rgyas la 'god phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum gnyis pa mchod pa byin brlab ni/ mched lcam rnams kyis lag g.yon dri chu thogs la 'di ltar brjod / hūm̐/ stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i/ spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang dag pa'i chus/ yid bzhin sprin phung mkha' la char 'bebs pa'i/ mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs kun dag gyur cig/ oṃ shuddhi shwa dha na ye swa hā/ zhes pas 'thor 'thung khrus sogs bya'o/ de nas/ ka dag klong nas sprul pa yi: gnam sa gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin: sman gtor rakta lha mor bcas: zad med gyur cig pū dza hoḥ zhes brjod/ gsum pa rten bskyed cing dgug pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dpal ldan bla ma dam pa che ge zhes bya ba de nyid sku yi rnam pa 510)gsal zhing yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dgongs pa zhi ba chos dbyings su gshegs pa che ge zhes bya ba'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes de nyid stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams dang 'jig rten las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa gang na bzhugs kyang*/ bdag sogs 'gro ba sems can thams cad la thugs rjes gzigs te skad cig gis 'dir byon par mdzad du gsol/ hūm̐/ ma lus 'gro ba'i mgon gyur thugs rje'i bdag /theg chen byang chub thugs bskyed dam tshig dang*// bdag sogs dad mos gdung bas spyan drangs ngor// 'gro la brtse bas deng 'dir gshegs su gsol// rtag par 'dzin rnams sgyu ma'i dpes bskul phyir// gzugs sku btang nas mya ngan 'da' bzhed gang*// 'jig rten mgon rnams dga' ldan lhar babs 511) nas// sgyu 'phrul lhum zhugs ji bzhin 'dir 'jug gsol// 'gro ba kun la snying rjes sgrib sbyong phyir// zag med rdo rje'i ting 'dzin la bzhugs nas// srid pa bar ma'i gnas kun rab sbyangs te// sprul pas gdul bya skyong phyir gshegs su gsol/

oṃ gu ru badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ bzhi pa sa lam la bar du gcod pa dang rjes 'brang gi bgegs sbyong ba ni/ zhi drag gi sbyong chas bshams la/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa= sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las trāṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun tshogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ a kā ro= sogs gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs te/ 512) gtor ma g.yas su bskor la/ sarba bighāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo= sogs nas/ gri hṇa daṃ ba lyā di swa hā/ lan gsum/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sa dang lam la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs zhi bas sbyong par 'os pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ting lo chang bu g.yon du bskor la/ oṃ suṃ bha ni= sogs lan gsum/ bde bar gshegs pa'i= sogs nas/ bgegs zhi drag phyed mas sbyong bar 'os pa thams cad chang bus lam rgyags/ ting los lam sgron gyi tshul du khyer la 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro na rdo rje'i khro bo rab tu 'bar bas bsreg cing brlag par gdon mi za'o/ lnga pa bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐: nga ni khro bo dbang chen te: bgegs dang log 'dren nga la nyon: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: 513) nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na: bdag nyid nga rgyal thugs khros te: thal ba'i rdul du brlag par byed: de bas da lta phyir dengs shig: ces dang*/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/

dpal ldan bla ma de nyid sku 'tsho zhing gzhos pa'i tshe na sku tshe thugs dam mdzad phrin la bar du gcod cing*/ gnas skabs zhi ba chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa'i dus 'dir/ slob 'bangs shul pa rnams kyis tshogs gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i chos spyod bcu bsags pas zab dgongs chos sku ka dag gi klong du rdzogs par byed pa dang*/ 514) mthar thug bstan 'gro'i bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i sa lam gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad du gyur pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren ye shes pa'i phyir 'brang gi bgegs dang bcas pa phyir dengs shig drag sngags rol mo yungs thun sogs kyis bskrad/ drug pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ srung 'khor brtan po bsgom la/ zhi khro'i dus yin na/ hūm̐/ nga ni rgyal ba zhi khro ste/ thugs kar gser gyi ga'u'i nang*/ bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya tshud/ steg 'og rdo rje'i gur sar gyur/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ bdun pa gnyis med sre ba ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngon po'i 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can gyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa mtshan zhes bya ba'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes de nyid mar me lta bur bkug nas rten gyi 515) spyi bo nas zhugs/ thugs kar thim pas bla ma'i sku dang ye shes dbyer med par gyur/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lhar bskyod spyan drangs dam ye bsre/ khrus dang phyag 'tshal mchod dang bstod bshags pa gsol gdab dbang len no/ zhes bcu las/ dang po dam tshig pa'i lhar gsal ba ni/ rang gi spyi bor nyi zla padma'i steng*// bka' drin mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rnam pa pad 'byung sprul sku'i cha lugs can// sku mdog dkar dmar zhi khro 'dzum bzhad ldan// dbu la paṇa zhu padma mthong grol gsol// za 'og phod steng chos gos rnam gsum mnabs// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin// g.yon pas ka li bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng*// 'chi med tshe bum lte ba'i thad du 'dzin// gru g.yon kha ṭwam̐

516) yum gyi tshul du brten// 'od zer nyi ma 'bum las gzi 'od 'bar// mi bzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs// 'bru gsum 'od 'phros zhing khams rab 'byams nas// sku gsum rtsa gsum chos srung bka' srung rnams// skar mda' rgyug bzhin mdun gyi lhar thim pas// skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ ces pas gsal gdab/ gnyis pa ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan bla ma'i lha tshogs rnams// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// skye med bla ma gshegs su gsol// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i pho brang nas// gsal dag bla ma gshegs su gsol// sprul pa sku yi pho brang nas// thugs rje can rnams gshegs su gsol// 'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li// sku dang thig le shigs se shig /'khor du yi dam lha tshogs dang*/ 517) /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi// byin gyis rlob phyir gshegs su gsol// gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod/ gsum pa dam ye sre ba ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tiṣṭha lhan dam tshig gi 'khor lo dang gnyis su med par padma nyi zla'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs par gyur/ ces pas gsol gdab/ bzhi pa khrus gsol rjes 'brel dang bcas pa ni/ nam mkha' gang ba'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang bcas te sku khrus gsol ba'i phrin las mdzad par gyur/ mi long ngos su sku gzugs 'char ba la las bum gyi chus khrus gsol te/ hūm̐/ bdag gis 518) dri ldan dri chab kyis// bla ma'i sku la sku khrus gsol// nyid la dri ma mi mnga' yang*// sdig sgrib dag pa'i rten 'brel bgyi/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka te sa ma shrī ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta= rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs mchog la// nyon mongs dri ma mi mnga' yang*// sems can sgo gsum sgrib sbyong phyir// gtsang ma'i chab kyis sku khrus gsol/ oṃ gu ru 519)sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣi ka te= 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong byed cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chus// grus legs mdzad la sku khrus gsol/ oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta= de bzhin du sbyin pa'i gnas su/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/ bsam gtan/ shes rab/ ces dang*/ ser sna'i gnas su/ tshul 'chal/ khong khro/ le lo/ rnam g.yeng*/ shes 'chal/ zhes bsgyur ba dang*/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas// bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni// gang la nyes pa mi mnga' ba'i/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas// dri ma rnam drug sbyangs mdzad cing*// rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pas/ khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi 520)mnga'// dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis// yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du// dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ zhes pa sngags bcas kyis khrus gsol/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa/ zhes bya ba de nyid sangs rgyas kyi zhing sogs gang du gshegs bzhud mdzad pa'i phar phyin drug la mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dag nas sems can gyi don du sprul pa rgyud mi chad par mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa ston par gyur cig

hūm̐/ ras dkar 'jam dri ldan pa yis// gu ru'i sku nyid phyi bar bgyi// sku la dri ma mi mnga' yang*// sdug bsngal bral ba'i rten 'brel bgyi// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab gos pas sku phyi'o/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi sho dha ni hūm̐/ zhes pas sku phyi/ hūm̐/ na bza' 521) mdzes ldan ngur smrig 'di// gu ru'i sku la gsol bar bgyi// sku la bsil ba mi mnga' yang*// bkrag mdangs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel bgyi// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i*// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi skyod rdo rje'i sku nyid la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag sogs rdo rje'i sku thob shog /sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog oṃ badzra wast+ra āḥhūm̐/ 522) zhes pas gos zung 'bul/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med// chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med// dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba// rgyal sras phan mdzad ldan pa'i byin rlabs kyis// nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel// rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa de nyid kyi sa dang lam gyi spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig

ces shis pa brjod/ 523) lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ sgo gsum gus pa chen pos/ bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin brlabs pa// bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis 'khor ba'i nyes pa ni// dran pa tsam gyis sel mdzad cing*// bla med byang chub thob mdzad pa'i// bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmor 'dud// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad 524)la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pas ni rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ a ti pū hoḥ

drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ zhabs bsil thogs la/ hūm̐/ gu ru zhabs dri dag bya'i phyir// zhabs bsil dri ldan 'di 'bul na// bdag ni tha mal lus po yang*// sems kyi zhabs bsil ser mor bskyed// zhabs la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ gu ru badzra pā dyaṃ pra titstsha āḥhūm̐/ me tog thogs la/ hūm̐/ gu ru'i spyan gzigs dgyes pa'i phyir// me tog mdzes pa 'bul ba na// bdag ni tha mal lus po yang*// sems kyi puṣpe dkar mor bskyed// spyan la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ gu ru badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ bdug spos thogs la/ hūm̐/ gu ru'i shangs mchod dgyes pa'i phyir// dri zhim bdug spos 525)'bul ba na// bdag ni tha mal lus po yang*// sems kyi dhu pe sngon mor bskyed// shangs la mchod pa= oṃ gu ru badzra dhū pe pra= mar me thogs la/ hūm̐/ gu ru'i phyag mchod dgyes= mar me gsal ba= bdag ni tha mal= sems kyi dwi paṃ dmar mor bskyed// phyag la mchod pa= oṃ gu ru badzra a lo ke pra= dri chab thogs la/ hūm̐/ gu ru'i sku lus bkrag dgyes phyir/ dri chab dri ldan= bdag ni tha mal= sems kyi gandhe ljang mor bskyed/ sku la mchod= oṃ gu ru badzra gandhe pra= zhal zas thogs la/ hūm̐/ gu ru'i sku bkrag 'don pa'i phyir// zhal zas ro mchog= bdag ni tha mal= sems kyi nai wi dya ser mo bskyed// ljags la mchod pa= oṃ gu ru badzra 526) nai wi dya pra= rol mo thogs la/ hūm̐/ gu ru'i snyan mchog dgyes pa'i phyir/ rol mo snyan pa 'bul ba na/ bdag ni tha mal= sems kyi shabda ser mor bskyed// snyan la mchod pa= oṃ gu ru badzra shabda pra= maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra bhu mi āḥhūm̐/ sogs maṇḍal so bdun pa spyi ltar la/ tshang zhing yid du 'ong ba 'di nyid dpal ldan bla ma zhi ba'i dbyings na bzhugs pa dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la gus pas 'bul bar bgyi'o/

thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas thugs bskyed brtse ba chen po'i mthus/ rnam mang mos pa ji bzhin sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i rol gar ji snyed gdul bya'i skal par 'tshams pa'i gzugs sku'i rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar ye shes kyi snang brnyan srid zhi'i dpal du 527) gsal bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gu ru i daṃ ratna maṇḍal la kaṃ nirya ta yā mi/ zhes dang*/ hūm̐/ kun gyi gtso bo ri rab gling*// ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bcas// gu ru rin po che la 'bul// bdag cag tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog oṃ gu ru badzra ratna maṇḍal la pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ bkra shis rtags brgyad thogs la/ hūm̐/ bkra shis gtso bo rtags brgyad ni// rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang*// gter chen bum pa padma bzang*// dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u// mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs// gu ru rin po che la 'bul// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par shog oṃ gu ru badzra aṣṭa maṅga la he tu swa hā/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad thogs la/ hūm̐/ bkris gtso bo rdzas brgyad ni/ yungs dkar durba bilba/ 528)dang*// gi waṃ li khri zhe mchog dang*// me long rnam dag dung dkar sogs// gu ru rin po che la 'bul// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par shog oṃ gu ru badzra aṣṭa maṅga la dra bya swa hā/ rgyal srid sna bdun thogs la/ hūm̐/ 'dod yon rtsa ba rin chen bdun// /'khor lo yid bzhin nor bu dang*// rab mdzes btsun mo mi bdag dang*// dpal gyi glang po cang shes rta// dmag dpon la sogs rin chen bdun// gu ru rin po che la 'bul// bdag cag tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog oṃ gu ru badzra sabta ratna pra tītstsha swā hā/ nang mchod ni/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos dpal ldan bla ma 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog bstsal du gsol/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pā ri wa 529) ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan ci mchis pa// mos blos dpal ldan bla ma la 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog= shabda= phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dri mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos= bzhes nas= gandhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// ro mchog khyad par 'phags pa ci mchis pa// mos blos= bzhes nas= rā sa= phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyan 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya khyad par 'phags pa ci= mos blos= bzhes nas= sparshe/ zhes sbyar bas mchod/ gsang mchod ni / hūm̐/ gu ru'i sku nyid dgyes pa'i phyir// rig ma rgyan ldan 'di 'bul na// bdag ni tha mal lus po 530)yang*// sems kyi rig ma mdzes par bskyed// sku la mchod pa 'bul bar bgyi/ oṃ gu ru badzra mu dra pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi thogs la/ hūm̐/ bdag gi skyabs gnas gu ru la// bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bdag ni tha mal lus po yang*// sems kyi bdud rtsi'i lha mor bskyed// gu ru khyed la 'bul ba na// thugs rjes bdag gzhan thams cad la// mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol// oṃ gu ru badzra pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gtor ma thogs la/ hūm̐/ bdag gi skyabs gnas gu ru la// gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bdag ni tha mal= sems kyi 'dod yon lha mor bskyed// gu ru khyed la 'bul ba na// thugs rjes bdag gzhan thams cad la// mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol/ 531) oṃ gu ru badzra ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ rakta thogs la/ hūm̐// bdag gi skyabs gnas gu ru la// rakta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bdag ni tha mal lus po yang*// sems kyi mchod pa'i lha mor bskyed// gu ru khyod la 'bul ba na// thugs rjes bdag gzhan thams cad la// mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol/

ooṃ gu ru badzra rakta kha raṃ khā hi/ zhes mchod do/ bdun pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ/ rdo rje'i sku ni sku yi mchog /tshangs dang brgya byin 'gran du med// nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs mnga' ba'i// chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ āḥ rdo rje'i gsung ni gsung gi mchog /che ba 'brug gis do zla med// snyan pa glu mas do zla med// thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs pa yi// longs spyod rdzogs skur 532)phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i thugs ni thugs kyi mchog /'gro ba'i don la nges par gzigs// tshangs pa brgya byin thugs kyis kyang*// do zla med pa'i bka' drin can// sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// e ma'o ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo nyid// 'khor 'das yon tan dpal dang ldan// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku// mdzes shing blta bas chog mi shes// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan// mu stegs ri dwags skrag mdzad pa// bla ma'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' 'dra// bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang*// rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa// bla ma'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ 533) /sku la tshad med bgrang du med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam gyur cing*// sna tshogs dbang phyug mi shigs pa'i// rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// brjod du med pa'i ngang nyid las// tshangs pa la sogs snyan pa'i dbyangs// phyogs bcu kun tu sgrog mdzad pa'i// rnam dag gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// phung po khams dang skye mched dag /gzung dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i// rtog pa kun las rnam grol ba'i// ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ brgyad pa bshags pa bya ba ni/

oṃ/ bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur pas// gu ru'i thugs dang gang 'gal ba// bshags bgyi badzra sa twa hūm̐/ oṃ/ sku yi dam tshig nyams pa bshags/ khyed kyi sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ āḥ gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa bshags/ khyed kyi gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ hūm̐/ thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags/ khyed 534)kyi thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ oṃ gu ru badzra sa twa sa ma ya= sogs yig brgya brjod/ thun mong du/ ji snyed su dag= sogs bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa bya'o/ dgu pa gsol 'debs ni/ na mo gu ru/ rnam dag chos dbyings mkha' ltar klong yangs shing*// rnam 'phrul 'gro ba'i don mdzad thugs rje can// rnam kun thugs rjes bzung mdzad sku drin can// rnam mkhyen bla ma'i sku la gus phyag 'tshal// dus gsum mdo sngags chos kyi char 'bebs shing*/ khams gsum sems can thar pa'i lam la bkod// theg gsum chos kyi dbang phyug sku drin can// gsang gsum bla ma'i gsung la gus= /rang byung dgongs pa mkha' ltar rab dwangs shing*// gang shar thugs rje'i tsha zer phyogs mthar khyab// rang grol ngo bo nyid ston sku drin can// rang rig bla ma'i thugs la// shes bya kun rdzogs 'dod don lhun grub 535)cing*// bkres ldan kun la sbyin pa rnam bzhi stsol// rnam pa kun tu skyong mdzad sku drin can// bla ma kun 'byung khyed la gus phyag 'tshal// mdzad pa'i phrin las bsil ldan nya rgyas shing*// mdzad pa rgya mtshos 'gro ba'i re ba skong*// mdzad phrin du ma skyong mdzad sku drin can// mdzad pa mthar phyin khyed la gus phyag 'tshal// 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas dpal ldan bla ma la// 'di ltar gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol btab mthus// 'di nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// 'di bzhin sku drin dam pas rjes bzung shog dus kun smin grol lam gyi sgor zhugs shing*// rim gnyis zab mo'i lam la brtan thob ste// rang byung ye shes lam mchog mthar phyin nas// sku gsum mthar phyin lam la gnas par shog

/bdag 536)kyang 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /bdag med rang rig chos sku mngon gyur nas// bdag la 'brel thogs kyis gtsos sems can kun// bdag dang dbyer med bde chen gnas phyin shog ces dang*/ bla ma sku gsum ma'i gsol 'debs sogs bya/ dmigs bsal du/ mkhyen no mkhyen no// sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo// drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma/ rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab mkhyen no/ zhes pas mtshon te mtshan nas bos pa'i rgyang 'bod ci nus dang*/ badzra gu ru= ci lcogs bzlas mthar/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi nyon mongs pa mtha' dag zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos thos bsam sgom gsum nyon mongs pa'i gnyen 537)por 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa spyan gyi 'bras bu bzhin du srung nus par byin= theg pa chen po'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la dad gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa bdag gi rgyud la skye bar byin= dad gus bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par byin= byang chub kyi sems nyams pa med pa bdag gi rgyud la skye bar gnas pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byin= bstan pa'i chos mtha' dag bdag gi rgyud la skye ba gnas pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byin= bde gsal mi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid gsum dang ldan pa bdag gi rgyud la skye bar= theg pa chen po gsang sngags mtha' dag gi snod du rung bar byin= mngon par shes pa rgya chen po thob par byin= sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag 538)rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par byin= thob nas kyang sems can nam mkha' dang mnyam pa smin par byed nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ bcu pa dbang bzhi len pa ni/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rgyal ba rdo rje dang*// bdag sogs 'gro la thugs rjes nyer dgongs te// bum gsang shes rab ye shes de kho na'i// ye shes mchog gis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod/

ces gsol ba gdab/ dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du dang*/ dbang po so so'i rang skal gyi dri ma sbyong tshul/ lam nyams len la dbab tshul/ dbang gi gnas skabs mthar thug gi ye shes thob tshul sogs tshig rjes su don dran bzhin pas/ gu ru'i spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi spyi bor thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam bskyed rim sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal 539)ba can du byas/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rtsa rlung sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam thig le sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ slar yang gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rdzogs pa chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du gyur/ bla ma'i 540)sku gsung thugs las thugs rje yi// 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'bru gsum tshul// mang 'phros rang gi gnas gsum dag tu thim// sgo gsum sgrib dag dbang bzhi thob par gyur/ ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bgrang*/ slar yang gu ru 'od zhu rang la thim// stong gsal 'dzin med chen por e ma hoḥ zhes pas bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang gi snying dbus su sku tshon gang ba la sems yun ring ci gnas su gzhag par bya'o/ de yang thugs khrid las/ gnyis med thugs rgyud 'phos pa'i ngang de las// ston ser nam mkha' bzhin du gsal dwangs gzhag /smra med yid ches 'di zhes brjod bya bral// 'di 'dra'i yin lugs ma mthong mthong rgyu zhig

/sa ler rang gsal rtog med rjen ne ba/ de tshe rang byung bla ma'i rang zhal mjal// 'gro mgon bla ma'i byin rlabs de tshe zhugs// de yi don rtogs rgyun du de ltar bsgom/ zhes 541) gsungs so/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ sri zhu 'bul zhing nongs pa bshags/ bsngo smon shis pa brjod pa'o/ zhes pa ltar gsum las/ dang po sri zhu 'bul zhing smon lam gsol ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur cing dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang ldan pa/ dpal ldan bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams kyis dkon mchog la mchod pa phul ba dang*/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bgyis pa dang*/ 'byung po la gtor ma btang ba dang*/ srung sdom dang*/ bzlas brjod dang*/ thos bsam dang sgom sgrub la sogs pa bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs ci bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bzlums te bsdoms nas/ rigs kun khyab bdag 542) 'dren mchog mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o/ phul nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi thugs dgongs khyad par can rnams gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig sa dang lam gyi rim pa'i spang bya dang gegs dang sgrib par gyur pa ci mchis pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig lam lnga sa bcu rim gyis bgrod nas bdag cag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi don du myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig sems can thams cad kyi don gang la gang 'dul gyi sprul pa'i sku'i mdzad pa rgyun mi 'chad par gyur cig der yang sku tshe'i 'du byed bskal pa rgya mtshor g.yo med du brtan cing*/ ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs 543)po che mdzad par gyur cig

bdag cag rnams la'ang bla ma bsten pa'i sgo nas bsags pa'i nyes pa sku la brdos pa/ rin la bsnyags pa/ gsung ngag bcag pa/ nyes pa gtam du brjod pa/ thugs tshod bzung ba/ thugs sun phyung ba la sogs pa nyes pa'i tshogs ci mchis pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal bar gyur cig mjal nas kyang mnyes pa byed par gyur cig mi mnyes pa skad cig kyang byed par ma gyur cig skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig gzung du gtub par gyur cig gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pas skyong bar gyur cig bskyang du gtub par gyur cig tshe rabs thams cad du 544) dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi brjed pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob par gyur cig dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rnam par thar pa la longs spyod par gyur cig mthar sems can thams cad kyi don du myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig

ces lan gsum brjod/ myur byon yod na skabs 'dir 'don no/ gnyis pa nongs pa bshags shing gshegs su gsol ba ni/ bdag blo gti mug rmongs pa'i dbang gyur te// legs spyad 'di la nyes par gyur pa gang*// skyes mchog rin chen rnams dang de yi sras// bdag nyid chen po rnams la bzod par gsol/ zhes yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ 'o/ mchog gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa zhi bar gshegs pa don gyi slad du mtshan smos pa/ zhes bya ba de nyid/ deng 'dir gzhi'i 'od gsal ka dag lhun grub chen po'i dbyings su lam gyi 545) 'od gsal skye med blo 'das zung du 'jug ste/ 'bras bu'i 'od gsal gnyis med khyab gdal chos sku'i klong yangs 'gro 'ong g.yo 'gul bral bar mnyam par bzhag pa 'di las da nas bzhengs te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i/ mkha' spyod dag pa'i gnas su gshegs te byang chub kyi spyod pa rgya mtsho skad cig gis rdzogs nas mi gnas pa'i zung 'jug mthar phyin par mdzad du gsol/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du gshegs nas rgyal ba rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i mchod pa dang phrin las bla na med pa bsgrub nas der yang zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzhol bar mdzad du gsol/ spyir ma gyur sems can gyi khams rnams gang la gang 'dul de la der ston mi zad rgyan 'khor rnam lnga'i sprul pa 'byams su klas pa nam mkha' ji srid bar 'gags pa med par ston pa 546) dang*/ khyad par zhing 'di'i gdul bya ris su ma chad pa rnams dang*/ yang sgos rjes su slob cing dad mos gus par ldan pa'i sems can rnams yal bar mi 'dor bar mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs der yang phyi nang gi rkyen nag po bdud kyi 'tshe bas mi gnod cing*/ thos bsam sgom gsum/ phar phyin drug sdom pa gsum/ bskyed rdzogs stong nyid snying rje sogs mthar phyin cing mdzad pa phrin las dar zhing rgyas pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/

bye brag snying po don gyi bstan pa mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi bstan pa 'di nyid nyams pa gso ba dang*/ gnas pa phyogs dus kun tu rgya cher spel ba dang*/ gdul bya rnam mang mtha' yas pa rnams kyang byang chub chen po'i lam du 'dren par 'gyur ba'i thugs bskyed rgya chen po dang smon lam mtha' gang btsan g.yel ba med par gsol ba 547)'debs pa lags/ zhes pas dam ye dbyer med dag pa'i zhing du gshegs nas/ der bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs dang gnyis su med par gyur par mos la thugs yid bsres te mnyam par gzhag gsum pa bsngo smon bya ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i tshig gang rung brjod/ phyogs dus rgyal ba= sogs kyis bsngo ba bya'o/ de ltar gnam chos kyi gzhung tshig rnams kyi lhu blangs pa 'di la byin rlabs kyi bab re 'ong ba'i dge mtshan cung zhig yod pa yin/ de ltar dbang med lag pa'i gar// 'khyugs te wa ti'i gnas nang du// sprang po sangs rgyas rdo rje yis// rang gzhan tshogs gnyis bsog phyir sbyar// nyes tshogs rtsa ba'i bla mar bshags// dge des bla mas rjes 'dzin smon// slar yang rang la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma dang skyes chen gzhan don yang srid 'byon pa la med du mi rung ba'i chings kyis spras pa 'di'ang rig pa 'dzin pa dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel// bkra shis// 548)
